title: the operator inbox reads troubles only through trouble's published store
intention: cairn/tools/operator_inbox/inbox.py read_troubles and read_all_troubles build a TroubleDevice to read the trouble store, and cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_operator_inbox.py does the same for its independent read: three reaches into trouble's device code. They read through trouble's published store tool (cairn/devices/trouble/tools/store/store.py: store_root, listing, CLEARED_DIR) instead, as the cairn device and web_server already do; the inbox stops folding pending emissions, which is the owner's write.
why: Measured 2026-11-11: the build inspector filed inspector-new-finding-encapsulation-holds naming cairn/tools/operator_inbox/inbox.py:285 and :996 and cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_operator_inbox.py:48 importing cairn.devices.trouble.trouble. RULE 1 and outline 2.3.7.1.3: outside trouble, the store is read through the tool trouble publishes.
how: In cairn/tools/operator_inbox/inbox.py: read_troubles(path) takes top = Path(path) or store.store_root(), live = store.listing(top), total = live + store.listing(top / store.CLEARED_DIR); read_all_troubles returns that same total. In cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_operator_inbox.py: the independent read counts *.json at the top of store.store_root(). New proof cairn/tools/operator_inbox/proofs/test_the_inbox_reads_troubles_through_the_store.py, three teeth.

clauses.claim: the build inspector's encapsulation_holds finds no breach from a file under cairn/tools/operator_inbox landing on cairn/devices/trouble
read_troubles and read_all_troubles over a scratch store count its top as live and cleared/ as cleared, return whole records, and change nothing in the store
cairn/tools/operator_inbox/inbox.py names cairn.devices.trouble.tools.store and no other trouble module

decisions.text: D1: read, never fold: the inbox is a reader; folding pending emissions is TroubleDevice's write in its own process (Law 6), the same footing the cairn pane and web_server stand on.
